person_note: The quote set repeatedly exposes Alex Cross’s participating first-person narration and also contains an Acadia-linked third-person villain beat; isolated third-person fragments were left unmarked or unclear where local attribution was inadequate. The sustained web excerpt independently shows two third-person Marcus Sunday/Acadia chapters followed by two first-person Alex chapters, while the whole-book review confirms multiple continuing narrative tracks. These are sustained base sections in different persons, so the book is ALTERNATING. No credible contradiction was found; the main limitation is that the direct web prose covers the opening, mitigated by the whole-book structural description and interior quote corroboration.
